name: Vehicles
description: Cars/bikes, identifiers, mileage, fuel or charging logs, and document/service references.
captureExamples: The car odometer is at 42,000 miles.
notes: Manufacturer/make and model belong to the parent Belongings item. Vehicle-specific identifiers, registration, model year, odometer and energy history belong here.

capture.identity: Resolve the Belongings item, then vehicle-specific identifiers such as VIN.
exclude: Duplicating manufacturer/model/ownership facts or treating a planned trip as odometer history.
capture.workflow: Maintain vehicle details and append observed usage/energy records; use shared Maintenance for service history.
